indicators.name: GDP at current prices, production approach
indicators.definition: National gross domestic product at current prices, total economic activity, using the production approach. The template excludes constant-price levels, growth rates and dollar-denominated measures in the same table.
indicators.caveats: Period labels can carry a trailing asterisk; retain the source label. GDP series are subject to revisions. The unit preserves the official UNITS[en] label from the PX-format response verified on 2026-10-19; no numeric conversion is applied. No portal series equivalence is asserted.

indicators.name: Resident population in Mongolia by geography
indicators.definition: Resident population in Mongolia, both sexes, national total by default. Geography selections use the source Region dimension and retain its administrative hierarchy; they must not be summed across overlapping levels.
indicators.geography: National default; region, aimag, soum/district, bag/khoroo source codes available
indicators.caveats: Resident population differs from citizen population and midyear population measures. Geography codes and administrative boundaries can change across years. The PXWeb national code 0 is unrelated to the portal code CO9999. The table is cross-listed; resolution follows the package's standard location rules.
